title: NeuroLab real data research walkthrough
research_mode: deterministic analysis and labeled saved replay; Meta inference paused

segments.text: This is NeuroLab AI, a research prototype for exploring maize field trials.
The question is which genotypes deserve further drought research, and why.
Meta research inference is paused. This walkthrough uses deterministic analysis on real data.
The Ghana combined source contains eight hundred and sixty-four plots and seventy-two genotypes.
There are four hundred and thirty-two records in each water regime.
The source citation and fingerprint identify the data used by the analysis.
Environment indices are not calendar years. Overlapping source files cannot increase the sample size.
I keep the research objective and select the full Ghana investigation.
It covers provenance, missingness, regime comparison, genotype summaries, trait associations and environment sensitivity.
Execution has a recorded seed, six analysis steps and six tool calls.
Its four exploratory criteria are declared before the tools run.
This processing view replays a previously completed deterministic investigation.
Each event corresponds to saved tool execution and evidence.
The maize illustration is not measured plant geometry. Replay makes no new Meta call.
Observed mean yields are about twelve hundred and thirty kilograms per hectare under drought.
The well-watered mean is about twenty-six hundred and sixteen kilograms per hectare.
Their descriptive ratio is about forty-seven percent. I inspect the uncertainty alongside it.
Water regime is confounded with trial environment, so this does not establish causation.
A large genotype mean is a research lead, not a proven field recommendation.
The next question is whether the shortlist depends on one environment.
A focused follow-up examines observed environment profiles and omitted-environment ranks.
This analyzes the same records. It does not add independent evidence or predict future harvests.
If ranks move substantially, I retain that uncertainty rather than hiding it.
The report links criteria, findings and counter-evidence to the saved numeric artifacts.
I can export the report, evidence and recorded events for inspection.
I stop when the supported questions are answered, or these data cannot resolve them.
The next field trial is a proposal for independent validation, not work already performed.
NeuroLab makes that decision traceable, with the limitations kept beside the result.
